# Programs whose output varies from run to run, always skipped by
# gopatina-parity (they count as skipped, never as passing). Each differed
# within 20 Go runs (go1.27.1, 2026-11-25), or, rarer, in a later run;
# three runs, the harness's own check, can agree by chance. NAME: why
gobyexample/closing-channels: goroutine scheduling order (the worker's and main's prints interleave)
gobyexample/epoch: the clock
gobyexample/goroutines: goroutine scheduling order
gobyexample/json: map iteration order
gobyexample/logging: log timestamps
gobyexample/pointers: pointer addresses
gobyexample/random-numbers: random numbers
gobyexample/range-over-built-in-types: map iteration order
gobyexample/rate-limiting: the clock
gobyexample/spawning-processes: the output of date
gobyexample/stateful-goroutines: random numbers
gobyexample/string-formatting: pointer addresses
gobyexample/temporary-files-and-directories: temporary file names
gobyexample/tickers: the clock
gobyexample/time-formatting-parsing: the clock
gobyexample/time: the clock
gobyexample/waitgroups: goroutine scheduling order
gobyexample/worker-pools: goroutine scheduling order
gotour/basics/packages: random numbers
gotour/concurrency/channels: goroutine scheduling order (two sums received as they finish)
gotour/concurrency/default-selection: the clock
gotour/concurrency/goroutines: goroutine scheduling order
gotour/methods/errors: the clock
gotour/methods/exercise-stringer: map iteration order
gotour/solutions/stringers: map iteration order
gotour/solutions/webcrawler: goroutine scheduling order
gotour/welcome/sandbox: the clock
